'''Marco Qwent''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Qwent Research Base''' in the permit-locked '''Sirius''' system. A former Sirius Corporation technical specialist, he works on Power Plants and Power Distributors and is discovered through '''[[Elvira Martuuk]]'''.<ref name="inara-marco">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/7/ Marco Qwent — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-marco">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Marco_Qwent Marco Qwent], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

His workshop provides '''Grade 4 Power Plant engineering''' and '''Grade 3 Power Distributor engineering'''.<ref name="inara-marco" />

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Sirius
* '''Facility:''' Qwent Research Base
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules
* '''Referral required:''' [[Elvira Martuuk]]
* '''System permit required:''' Yes

The Sirius permit and Marco's Engineer invitation are separate access conditions. A Commander may know Marco's location without yet being able to enter the system or use his workshop.

== Access requirements ==

Marco's direct access conditions are:<ref name="inara-marco" />

# Reach Grade 3 access and progress approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with [[Elvira Martuuk]].
# Obtain the Sirius system permit and the Engineer invitation issued through Sirius Corporation.
# Carry '''25 units of Modular Terminals''' to Qwent Research Base.
# Donate all 25 units to Marco.

Modular Terminals are commodities rather than Raw, Manufactured, or Encoded Engineering materials. The donation therefore requires 25 tonnes of cargo capacity.

For Sirius Corporation reputation, the permit, the invitation mission, Modular Terminal acquisition, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Marco Qwent]].

{{Field note|Elvira's referral reveals Marco. It does not grant the Sirius permit, complete the Sirius Corporation invitation, or satisfy the Modular Terminal donation.}}

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Marco increases by:<ref name="inara-marco" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* selling commodities at Qwent Research Base.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Marco supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-marco" />

== Engineering services ==

Neither of Marco's module families reaches Grade 5.<ref name="inara-marco" /><ref name="edwiki-marco" />

{| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;"
! Module
! Maximum grade
|-
| [[Power Plant]]
| '''Grade 4'''
|-
| [[Power Distributor]]
| '''Grade 3'''
|}

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]]. Marco can apply compatible Experimental Effects to Power Plants and Power Distributors even when a higher blueprint grade was installed by another Engineer.

=== Power Distributor version note ===

In Live, Marco's Grade 3 Power Distributor services include the Operations-era '''Balanced''' and '''Support Focused''' blueprints for compatible Merc modules. These additions are not part of Legacy Engineering.<ref name="inara-marco" /><ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous — 4.4.0.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 27 May 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Marco blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A blueprint pinned with Marco cannot exceed his Grade 4 Power Plant or Grade 3 Power Distributor limit, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Marco directly introduces three Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with him:

* '''[[Professor Palin]]'''<ref name="inara-palin">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/3/ Professor Palin — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Chloe Sedesi]]'''<ref name="inara-chloe">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/25/ Chloe Sedesi — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Lori Jameson]]'''<ref name="inara-lori">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/20/ Lori Jameson — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own invitation or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
